response.justification: Bogdan is a solid, versatile full-stack software craftsman with strong depth in web/embedded/testing infrastructure and ~15+ years of experience, but he lacks the AI/ML strategic depth, recognized AI expertise, and director-level strategic advisory experience this Principal Engineer AI Strategy role requires. His current AI exposure (MCP tooling, agentic frameworks) is recent and limited to individual contributor tooling work, not the demonstrated AI product leadership, cloud strategy, or executive-level customer advisory experience the role demands.
strengths: Broad, deep hands-on engineering experience across web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure spanning 15+ years
Demonstrated technical leadership through workshops, talks, open-source projects, and mentoring
Recent exposure to AI-agent infrastructure (MCP, agentic workflows) shows adaptability toward AI tooling
concerns: No evidence of recognized AI/ML expertise, published AI products, or platforms built with AI at scale
No apparent experience in strategic advisory roles with executives, enterprise customers, or partners
Career trajectory is IC-focused (Senior/Staff) without director-level scope, strategy-setting, or org-wide influence

key_factors.factor: Lack of demonstrated AI/ML strategic expertise and AI products built
No director-level strategic advisory or executive customer-facing experience
Strong general engineering breadth and 15+ years experience
